name: .264 Cal-085gr Hammer Hunter®

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "g7-bc= .158"; the method is not stated.

slowestTwist.raw: Required twist rate is 1-11″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "Does the Creedmoor really need more??? I don’t think so! With this pure copper 85gr Hammer Hunter™ running around 3400 fps plus, it makes the Creed a 400 yard point blank range rig. This combo is still traveling nearly 2100 fps at 500y! This kind of speed with a bullet that will retain the same 60% weight with high or low velocity impacts is going to be tough to beat for the normal to mid range hunter."
